text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 10 billion dirhams ($1.09 billion) were invested by the Office Cherifien du Phosphate (OCP) in the past four years.
- King Hassan congratulates Chechnya's elected president.
- The OCP posts an output of 20.8 million tonnes of phosphates in 1996.
- U.N chief Kofi Annan says the referendum process in the Western Sahara has stalled and the United Nations is reviewing its political approach to the situation.
